comment: Irencrag Feat restrictor vs SUSPEND (claude-play sweep 2026-11-21, seeds 9300009/9300012): a suspend is not a cast, so 'suspend Rift Bolt + Irencrag Feat + Worldfire' is legal and must be enumerated. Seven Mountains: Feat on four floats 7, three more = 10 = {R} suspend + Worldfire {6}{R}{R}{R}; Worldfire sets life to 1, the Bolt kills at the T5 upkeep. Before the fix the restrictor counted the suspend as a second spell after Feat and the line was unfindable at any budget.
